source.name: Greevil Egg
source.description:
Relic Consumable: Click to Use
 Put a piece into an egg which has a chance to grow once every round. You can break it anytime, hatching a piece according to the points.
notes: ★★ for no less than 3 points, ★★★ for no less than 9 points.
Hatching points deduct pieces from the chess pool and will stop growing when there are no pieces in the chess pool.
